frame: the catalogue's, from the key block: its corner at (0, 0, 0), x and z as the catalogue's dx and dz, yaw as the game's (0 = +z, -90 = +x); the key block is the layout's take-off (its 0, 0, 0, the runway's last block, where the walk stands when stuck) where it has a block to stand on, else its start block; landing, feet (standing on the key block), landingFeet and spot from it; spotFeet the feet at the spot (on the catalogue's start block, which is from)
robustness: robust of variations: from the spot and 12 points up to 0.08 off it (those the player stands on: starts), each of 13 yaw offsets (0, +-0.3, +-0.6, +-1, +-1.5, +-2.5, +-4 degrees on every tick), the first jump moved by -1, 0 or +1 tick (where it stays in the inputs), the start delayed 0 or 1 tick; landed: standing on the landing within the inputs and 10 more ticks keys up, then coming to rest on it (keys up or the shift key held), or for a ladder held on it at the end; covered: the starts from which at least one variation lands
